projects.name: Autonomous Driving Perception Models
projects.description: Lucid Motors, 2025. Developed CNN and YOLO-based computer vision models for object detection and lane tracking, improving detection accuracy by 25% on autonomous driving datasets. projects.name: Predictive Maintenance for Manufacturing
projects.description: TCS, 2022. Built LSTM and time-series models on IoT sensor data to predict equipment failures, reducing unplanned downtime by 25% for client manufacturing operations. Implemented MLflow-based monitoring and automated retraining, reducing model deployment time by 40% and improving prediction reliability.

projects.name: NLP Document Automation
